en.content: From 6 different novels and 3 different dictionaries, 4 novels and 1 dictionary are to be selected and arranged in a row on a shelf so that the dictionary is always in the middle. Then the number of such arrangement is :
en.explanation:
From 6 different novels 4 novels can be chosen = ways

And from 4 different dictionaries 1 can be chosen = ways

From 6 different novels and 3 different dictionaries, 4 novels and 1 dictionary can be chosen = ways

Let 4 novels are N1, N2, N3, N4 and 1 dictionary is D1.

Dictionary should be in the middle. So the arrangement will be like this

_ _ D1 _ _

On those 4 blank places 4 novels N1, N2, N3, N4 can be placed. And 4 novels can be arrange ways.

Total no of ways = = 1080
